import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    len_s = random.randint(1, 5000)
    s = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(len_s))
    t = list(s)
    if random.random() < 0.5:
        random.shuffle(t)
    else:
        t[random.randint(0, len_s - 1)] = random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase)
    t = ''.join(t)
    return s, t
